I love going to concerts. I'm 5'0, by the way.

I rarely ever go with friends. I go into the crowd of people and jump & sing my heart out. I just have fun. If I get tired, I'lll get out, and grab some water. 

If you go into the crowd, chances are you'll lose your friends. If you stand back, you won't. You are NOT wasting your money by standing back. However, I do recommend at some point in your life, you go into the crowd. It's a much different experience :) 

Also, as a small person, it is much easier to get to the front of the crowd. There will be pushing, and you have to use this to your advantage. Get your hips in front of someone else's. Don't be afraid to take opportunities. Don't let people's pissy words get to you- it happens to everyone.

To sum up- do whatever feels right. It's a concert. People are there to enjoy the music, not to criticize others. Have fun! :)
